experienceLevels.label: Beginner
designRules: one or two coaching cues at a time

experienceLevels.label: Intermediate
designRules: add one decision, direction, or passive opponent
use slightly tighter space only when control is consistent
progress one variable at a time
preserve recovery so quality remains high

experienceLevels.label: Advanced
experienceLevels.userMessage: Advanced recommendations are being developed and reviewed.
designRules: increase perception and decision complexity before adding physical load
retain the same safety and supervision limits

goals.label: Match readiness
goals.description: Arrive confident and fresh for the next fixture.

goals.label: Strength
goals.description: Build age-appropriate movement control and force foundations.

goals.label: Speed
goals.description: Develop quick reactions, acceleration mechanics, and controlled stopping.

goals.label: Endurance
goals.description: Improve repeatable football movement through play and ball-based intervals.

goals.label: General fitness
goals.description: Build a balanced foundation of ball skill, movement, and recovery habits.

u5-u8.match_readiness: Familiar touches, simple movement, and confidence—not fitness loading.
u5-u8.strength: Balance, crawling, landing, rising, and playful body control—not weight training.
u5-u8.speed: Short reaction games with complete recovery—not repeated hard sprinting.
u5-u8.endurance: Active play with natural pauses—not running laps.
u5-u8.general_fitness: A varied play session involving the ball and whole-body movement.

u9-u12.match_readiness: Ball confidence and simple decisions while preserving freshness.
u9-u12.strength: Supervised bodyweight movement literacy and landing control.
u9-u12.speed: Short acceleration, stopping, and reaction quality with generous rest.
u9-u12.endurance: Small-sided or ball-based intervals rather than isolated long running.
u9-u12.general_fitness: Technical, coordination, and game-based movement in balance.

u13-u15.match_readiness: Dynamic activation, technical sharpness, and low-fatigue game cues.
u13-u15.strength: Technique-first bodyweight and light-resistance foundations under qualified supervision.
u13-u15.speed: Acceleration and deceleration mechanics while fresh, with full recovery.
u13-u15.endurance: Football-specific tempo and small-sided repeated efforts with controlled load.
u13-u15.general_fitness: Progressive technical, movement-control, and aerobic foundations.

u16-u17.match_readiness: Schedule-aware primer that protects freshness and reinforces position-relevant actions.
u16-u17.strength: Compact supervised unilateral and core strength that complements football.
u16-u17.speed: High-quality acceleration, deceleration, and direction changes with full rest.
u16-u17.endurance: Controlled football intervals selected around team and match load.
u16-u17.general_fitness: Balanced football athleticism with explicit load and recovery management.
